REGIONS.hollowcrypt.//: Battle Re-work Part 13a (note 07): the Hollow Crypt, under the Misty Isle -- reached from the Isle's page; not on the painted map yet (WORLD_SOON), a drawn scene until Cam paints it (note 10).
REGIONS.hollowcrypt.name: Hollow Crypt

needs.how: to cross to the Isle and see where the steps go

REGIONS.hollowcrypt.blurb: Steps under the Misty Isle, older than the pirates. Lanterns that nobody lights, and something that keeps the dead awake.

CRYPT_MONSTERS.//: Level 38-42 creatures (V8, was 44-48), set against the Jungle. Wisps: the only life essence there is (Cam's rule), about one in eight; they dodge and shrug off blades, so magic and nets do best (note 07). Blood essence from the crypt's dead, for blood runes. Every kill drops bones (the game's rule) -- even a wraith's, even a wisp's: what's left of whoever it was.

PEOPLE.hollowcrypt.name: Sexton Hobb
PEOPLE.hollowcrypt.says: Mind the third step. And the fourth. Actually, mind all of them.

quests.name: Restless
quests.text: "They won't lie still with her down there. Put fifty of them back to sleep -- gently, mind."

quests.name: Candles for the crypt
quests.text: "Morvane put the lanterns out. I'd like them lit again. Twenty candles, if you would."

quests.name: The ossuary
quests.text: "The ossuary's half empty. Not because they've left -- they wander. Bring me bones and I'll put them back where they belong."

quests.name: Red ink
quests.text: "The old altar still works, if you can stand it. Fifty blood runes -- I keep the crypt's register in them."

quests.name: Deeper down
quests.text: "Further down, they're older and crosser. Two hundred, and the lower halls are quiet again."

quests.name: Every cranny
quests.text: "Sextons hide things. I should know -- so did the last one. Find it all."

WORKSHOPS.cryptmerchant.name: The crypt merchant
WORKSHOPS.cryptmerchant.says: A little life essence, for them as can't catch a wisp. It isn't cheap. Nothing down here is.

NECRO_ITEMS.//: Icon sheet 72. Life essence: wisps only (and a little from the crypt merchant). Blood essence: the crypt's dead, made into blood runes at the Blood altar (Runecrafting 38, V8). The Blood Book: Morvane's, the first time you beat her. The potion of life essence (apothecary, Herblore 40, V8) heals a risen pet; nothing else but Necromancy does. The bone staff: a Necromancer's staff (+10% to the risen), and the Necromancer's New Game Plus gift.

CRYPT_STOCK.//: The crypt merchant: life essence at a high price, three a day at most (the Economist's sink, and a help for the unlucky).

NECRO_SPELLS.//: Note 07's eight, in the Spellbook once you've learnt Necromancy (an Arcane's): `gate` = points in the Necromancy branch it waits for. raise / mend / army / rites take your turn and deal nothing; the rest are cast like any spell. Runes: blood (the Blood altar) and death.

raisefallen.name: Raise the fallen
raisefallen.about: Brings one of your risen into this fight

menddead.name: Mend the dead
menddead.about: Heals your most hurt risen a quarter

wither.name: Wither
wither.about: A curse: they hit softer for 4 rounds

bonespear.name: Bone spear
bonespear.about: Goes through a guard: much likelier to land

soulsiphon.name: Soul siphon
soulsiphon.about: Heals your risen for half of what it deals

armydead.name: Army of the dead
armydead.about: Every risen acts twice this round

lastrites.name: Last rites
lastrites.about: A risen that falls this fight stands up once, at 30%

NECRO.//: The rules (note 07, with the Mathematician's numbers). quest: what Sorceress Nyx wants (V8: 120 blood runes, was 200). offerRank: the tower rank whose mage offers it (V8: 4, Nyx; was the Archmage). raise: life essence = a risen's battle level / perLevel, rounded up, x step for every time it was raised before. slots: risen in a fight at once (the tree adds). In a fight: each risen strikes once a round (dmg x its numbers); the creature turns on one of them `target` of the time. They don't heal on their own -- only Mend the dead, Soul siphon and the potion. xpShare: half a pet's battle xp (Cam: 'trained after death but at a slower rate'). Old graves (no battle level): half the pet's level, plus its rarity's bonus, at least 5 and at most 30 (Q9). vigil: a Necromancer at the graveyard at night, once a night, may meet a wisp (chance). raisedBy: the line a risen says it with, by its type (the Narrative Designer: 'a line from each pet when it's raised').
NECRO.offer: "Now that you've beaten me, let me teach you something the tower forgot -- an older line of magic than any of ours. I'll teach it to you, if you wish."
NECRO.accepted: "Then you'll need the Blood Book. Morvane the Lich keeps it in the Hollow Crypt, under the Misty Isle. Bring it to me, with a hundred and twenty blood runes, and I'll open it for you."
NECRO.declined: "As you like. The offer stands -- I'm not going anywhere."
NECRO.taught: Nyx opens the Blood Book. The letters move. "Gently, now. You bring them back -- you don't own them. They'll thank you for it."
NECRO.raised: opens its eyes, and knows you. It seems glad.

raisedBy.beast: shakes itself, sniffs your hand, and leans against your leg as if it had never been away.
raisedBy.bird: ruffles feathers that aren't quite there, and hops up onto your arm.
raisedBy.water: blinks, cool and pale as river mist, and swims a slow circle round your feet.
raisedBy.reptile: stretches in a patch of light that isn't there, and settles beside you, content.
raisedBy.bug: clicks softly, three times -- the way it always used to when you came home.
raisedBy.spirit: was half a ghost already. It looks rather pleased to be one properly, and to see you.

NECRO.ilse: Ilse, back at the tower, catches your sleeve on the stairs: "Nyx told me. It's a long road -- here's the whole of it, so you don't lose the thread."
